<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class ReportController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Generate a formatted report based on user-supplied template
     */
    public function generate(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'template' => 'required|string|max:2048',
            'data' => 'required|array',
            'output_format' => 'in:pdf,html,txt',
        ]);

        $template = $request->input('template');
        $data = $request->input('data');
        $outputFormat = $request->input('output_format', 'txt');

        // Process template placeholders
        $rendered = $this->renderTemplate($template, $data);

        // Log the report generation for audit
        $this->logReportGeneration($request->user(), $template);

        // Save rendered output
        $filename = 'reports/' . uniqid('rpt_') . '.' . $outputFormat;
        Storage::disk('local')->put($filename, $rendered);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'file' => $filename,
            'preview' => substr($rendered, 0, 500),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Render template with sprintf-style format strings
     * Supports positional arguments for complex reports
     */
    private function renderTemplate(string $template, array $data): string
    {
        // Replace named placeholders first
        $intermediate = $template;
        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($value) || is_numeric($value)) {
                $intermediate = str_replace('{{' . $key . '}}', (string)$value, $intermediate);
            }
        }

        // Process sprintf-style format directives for numeric formatting
        // This allows users to specify precision like %0.2f for currency
        if (preg_match_all('/%[0-9.*]*[dfsxXo%]/', $intermediate, $matches)) {
            $formatArgs = array_values(array_filter($data, 'is_numeric'));
            if (count($matches[0]) <= count($formatArgs)) {
                try {
                    $intermediate = sprintf($intermediate, ...$formatArgs);
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                    Log::warning('Template format error', ['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
                }
            }
        }

        return $intermediate;
    }

    /**
     * Log report generation with template fingerprint
     */
    private function logReportGeneration($user, string $template): void
    {
        $fingerprint = md5($template);
        $userId = $user ? $user->id : 'anonymous';

        // Use error_log for syslog integration
        $logMessage = sprintf(
            "[REPORT] user=%s fingerprint=%s template_preview=%.40s",
            $userId,
            $fingerprint,
            $template
        );
        error_log($logMessage);
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve a previously generated report
     */
    public function download(Request $request, string $filename)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'filename' => 'string',
        ]);

        // Sanitize path traversal
        $safeName = basename($filename);
        $path = 'reports/' . $safeName;

        if (!Storage::disk('local')->exists($path)) {
            abort(404, 'Report not found');
        }

        $content = Storage::disk('local')->get($path);
        return response($content)
            ->header('Content-Type', 'text/plain')
            ->header('Content-Disposition', 'attachment; filename="' . $safeName . '"');
    }

    /**
     * Debug endpoint - reads arbitrary log for troubleshooting
     * Protected by admin middleware in routes
     */
    public function debugLog(Request $request)
    {
        $logFile = $request->input('file', 'laravel.log');
        $logPath = storage_path('logs/' . $logFile);

        if (!file_exists($logPath)) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Log not found'], 404);
        }

        $lines = array_slice(file($logPath), -100);
        return response()->json(['lines' => $lines]);
    }
}

No MAC policy enforced. Storage directory at /var/www/app/storage with standard Unix permissions (755/644). The debugLog endpoint is registered under admin middleware but the middleware only checks a session-based is_admin flag. PHP error_log writes to /var/log/php-fpm/error.log.
